overall: Atlanta is experiencing a post-frontal pattern today with mostly sunny skies and a brisk northwest wind at 10–15 mph, gusting to 25 mph. The warming trend through the week (83→86→89→91°F) confirms high pressure is building back in, but today represents the coolest day of the stretch.
